---
description: Write the release record for a phase whose slices are all merged, and set each slice released.
argument-hint: "P<n>"
slicekit-managed: v0.0.0-test
---
Run `npx --no-install slicekit instructions --command release $ARGUMENTS` and follow the procedure it prints. The procedure is the only source of this command's rules.

Writing rules: `.claude/skills/slicekit-writing/SKILL.md`.
